title: Remove the remote MCP connection option that fails initialization
prompt:
Change only src/app/docs/guides/claude-setup/page.tsx among production files. Evidence: src/app/docs/guides/claude-setup/page.tsx:68-81 advertises a direct HTTP MCP connection to https://noui.bot/api/v1. That handler recognizes tools/call and tools/list but its unsupported-method response at src/app/api/v1/route.ts:232-236 rejects initialize. A local execution of POST with a JSON-RPC initialize request returned HTTP 400 and code -32601. A desktop MCP client following the displayed remote configuration therefore cannot complete its initial handshake.

Remove the unsupported HTTP alternative and replace it with a concise statement that this guide uses the packaged stdio server and that the API index URL is not a supported desktop MCP transport. Preserve the existing npx-based configuration and the rest of the guide. Do not implement a new transport or change any route, credential, or authentication behavior. Keep the correction narrowly about the connection method.

Add exactly one new test file, tests/claude-guide-remote-transport.test.ts. Render the actual page via in-memory TypeScript transpilation and JSX stubs. Parse the remaining MCP configuration block, asserting the npx command and package arguments are intact. Assert there is no remote URL configuration for the API index and that the transport limitation is visible. Run node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/claude-guide-remote-transport.test.ts. Use no real desktop client, service requests, or secrets. No deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflow, package.json, or auth changes. work on the assigned branch you are on.
